lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 fixed the reviewer's WARNING against src/commands/stats.ts:191 (defaultWriteArtifact / the --rebuild branch of runStatsCycles): a raw writeFileSync call with no guard let an ENOENT (missing scripts/cam/ dir) escape as an uncaught exception with a full stack trace, asymmetric with the sibling read path's graceful 'No cycle data recorded yet' contract. Fixed by wrapping the writeArtifact(serializeCycleMetrics(result)) call at stats.ts:237-240 in a try/catch, emitting printError (src/logging/color.ts, the established convention -- see readPenContentFromMain in src/commands/suggestions.ts:170) with the resolved artifact path plus a remediation hint ('scripts/cam/ must exist...'), and returning exit code 1 instead of letting the exception propagate. Added a regression test in test/commands/stats-cycles.test.ts injecting a throwing writeArtifact (an ENOENT-shaped Error matching the reviewer's repro) and asserting the call is caught (no uncaught exception) and the return code is 1. Full quality spine (bun run check:all, all gates: typecheck, tests, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet) is green. No other reviewer findings from round 2 remain in prd.json's notes for this story id; if the review round produced additional US-R2-NNN fix stories they are independent siblings, not covered by this change.
